visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary continuity work, split record custody, the missing sensor interval, four political responses, and four state-gated ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the collar overview, ordinary shift, each preparation choice, classification opening, sensor-history rupture, each evidence response, final disposition, and each ending family. visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt restates the visible collar geometry, light, materials, bodies, interfaces, and relevant records in plain visual language. Character refs are assembled only for named characters visible in that frame.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Humane retro-industrial science-fiction storybook illustration, precise ink linework under thin gouache color, graphite-gray collar machinery, sodium amber work lamps, cold cyan pressure displays, small areas of union red, tactile worn materials, readable silhouettes and interfaces, cinematic workplace framing.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from the global_style_cue, the complete scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for visible named characters or groups, and triggered state or global branch image modifiers. Generated images provide illustration and material mood; the scene_set map owns layout continuity.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view from the inward crew ramp of a compact rotating-side transfer-collar maintenance bay inside an asteroid-built habitat near Ceres. The outward side curves in graphite-gray layered steel and dark structural composite around a massive frame-transfer bearing, crossed by ribbed supports, bundled coolant trunks, pressure taps, cable trays, and a cyan-lit seal manifold. Boots, cups, and tools settle toward the grated outward deck. Hubward, a round freight iris opens toward a guide-railed low-gravity transfer tube; beside it sit a black ore-gate handwheel and a narrow white life-safety bypass pipe. Three waist-high consoles form a triangle around a scarred metal meal table: red-sealed union handovers, amber AU safety exceptions, and white SolEx certification history. A red union locker is bolted under the table; a yellow clipped service rail continues through an outward hatch. Len Rusk, a stocky brown mechanic in patched gray coveralls and red union armband, pours tea while lean Pax Ader studies a tethered slate, pale Vela Quist stands at the amber console, and dark-skinned Imri Senn sits at the white console. Five tired maintenance workers occupy the ramp and table under sodium work lamps.
